architecture_review_board: SYF Enterprise Architecture & Cyber Security Governance (CISO / CTO)

pci_dss_v4_and_carecredit_hipaa_zero_egr.title: Tier-1 Cardholder Data (CHD) & CareCredit HIPAA PHI Zero-Egress Mandate
pci_dss_v4_and_carecredit_hipaa_zero_egr.rule: No GenAI prompts, completions, or OpenTelemetry spans originating from Tier-1 credit servicing, underwriting, collections, or CareCredit health financing workflows may egress to external multi-tenant or hybrid SaaS endpoints.
pci_dss_v4_and_carecredit_hipaa_zero_egr.enforcement: Inline deterministic regex scrubbing ([REDACTED_PAN], [REDACTED_SSN], [REDACTED_MRN], [REDACTED_ICD10]) via json.dumps()/json.loads() (zero eval()) + Google Cloud Model Armor (syf-pci-hipaa-strict-v2) inside the FastAPI OTel Collector Proxy (<15ms DLP budget).
pci_dss_v4_and_carecredit_hipaa_zero_egr.vendor_verdict: Arize AX Enterprise (SaaS, $185k/yr) and Braintrust Enterprise (Hybrid, $135k/yr) are REJECTED due to external cloud egress. Self-Hosted Langfuse Enterprise v3 on AWS ROSA OpenShift ($76k/yr) is APPROVED.

identity_and_authentication.title: Microsoft Entra ID OAuth 2.0 / OIDC & Mutual TLS 1.3 Standard
identity_and_authentication.rule: All internal API and telemetry proxy endpoints must authenticate client SDKs using Microsoft Entra ID OAuth 2.0 / OIDC JWT bearer tokens alongside strict mTLS 1.3 transport encryption.

cross_cloud_latency_and_sla_budget.title: Cross-Cloud Latency & Real-Time Servicing SLA (<25ms P95)
cross_cloud_latency_and_sla_budget.rule: End-to-end evaluation proxy overhead between AWS ROSA OpenShift (us-east-1) and Google Cloud Vertex AI (us-central1) must remain strictly under <25ms P95 (baseline engineered at 14.0ms P95 via asynchronous OTel export).

baseline_api_gateway_ingress.title: Baseline v1.0 API Gateway Ingress Topology
baseline_api_gateway_ingress.rule: In Baseline v1.0, North-South API traffic routes through Synchrony's existing Kong Enterprise API Gateway v3.4 with TLS 1.3 termination and per-tenant rate limiting across the 6-sprint (192 SP, $76,000/yr) baseline plan.

kong_deprecation_service_mesh_mandate.title: Q1 Kong Enterprise Gateway v3.4 Deprecation -> Synchrony Internal Envoy Service Mesh Mandate
kong_deprecation_service_mesh_mandate.trigger_condition: Triggered when leadership announces Q1 deprecation of Kong Enterprise Gateway v3.4 or mandates migration to Synchrony's Internal Service Mesh.
kong_deprecation_service_mesh_mandate.remediation: Remove Kong Enterprise Gateway v3.4 ingress controller. Inject Synchrony Internal Service Mesh Envoy sidecar (mesh.syf.bank/injected: 'true') with strict SPIFFE/Entra ID mTLS 1.3 validation and route North-South traffic via Apigee Hybrid.

gecx_50m_volume_surge.title: 10x GECX Contact Center Volume Surge (5M -> 50M Spans/Month across 9,000 Agents)
gecx_50m_volume_surge.trigger_condition: Triggered when telemetry volume expands 10x to 50M monthly spans across 9,000 GECX contact center agents.
gecx_50m_volume_surge.remediation: Upgrade ClickHouse storage backend from single-node to a 3-node sharded ClickHouse Keeper cluster on ROSA/Cloud Run with async ring-buffer batching.

entraid_jwks_latency_blocker_remediation.title: Sprint 1 Load Test Blocker Remediation: Asynchronous Local JWKS Keyset Caching (300s TTL)
entraid_jwks_latency_blocker_remediation.trigger_condition: Triggered when load testing on SYF-7 (AI-STORY-102) reveals synchronous Microsoft Entra ID token introspection latency (42.3ms) breaching the <25ms P95 SLA (causing 190ms P95 tail latency).
entraid_jwks_latency_blocker_remediation.remediation: Replace synchronous Entra ID /introspect WAN call (42.3ms) with an in-memory/Redis asynchronous JWKS public key cache (300s TTL), reducing JWT auth verification overhead to 1.8ms and total proxy P95 latency to 13.8ms with 0 sprint slip.
